menu
The Coin Rug definitely feels the most special.
It is a modern take on a 200-year-old American penny rug tradition. Every single felt circle is hand-stitched onto a wool felt top layer with zero glue.
Because of all that detailed handwork, it feels like a unique piece of art, making it a really memorable gift.

turns.replyTail:
Here to help you shop
If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
menu
To start an exchange or return, they would just need to reach out to our Customer Care team within 30 days of purchase.
The item must be unused and in its original condition. Our team will provide a Return Authorization Number (RMA) and the correct warehouse address for shipping.
For change-of-mind returns or exchanges, shipping costs both ways and a 15% restocking fee apply.
Is there anything else I can help you with?
